Director Oliver Stone talks with Rogan, in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience, about the cover-up he sees behind the JFK assassination. Stone's film JFK made him the most famous voice of the case for a generation. Decades later, he has not moved from his ground.

He lays out the points he trusts: the wounds, the witnesses, and the files still held back. Rogan asks why the story will not die and what full disclosure would change. The segment is a veteran storyteller's brief for the idea that the public was never told the whole truth about Dallas.
podcast-joerogan-xPbZ19A03Hw:
Billionaire Robert Bigelow talks UFOs with Joe Rogan in episode 1612 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Bigelow, who made his money in hotels and aerospace, spent years funding serious UFO research. He bought Utah's Skinwalker Ranch, a site famed for strange events, to study it.

Bigelow explains why a hard-headed businessman takes the phenomenon seriously. He describes the ranch research and the government contracts his company held on the topic. Rogan asks what Bigelow believes after decades of spending on the question. Money meets mystery here, and the money man speaks with unusual candor.
